### Load annotation file

- Load ensembl annotation gtf

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/export2/home/koustav/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Load ERAP2 KD proteomics

```{r}

differential_protein_enrichment_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-01-erap2-OV-rots-differential-enrichment-analysis-results.rds"))
erap2_ov_df <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "ERAP2_overexpression_proteomics.csv"))
unimputed_effect_df <- differential_protein_enrichment_list$unimputed_data
biomart_info_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "00-01-erap2-ov-biomart-metadata.rds"))

gene_name_indexes <- vapply(unimputed_effect_df$protein_name, function(x){
    if(x %in% erap2_ov_df[,"T..Protein.Names"]){
        return(which(erap2_ov_df[,"T..Protein.Names"] == x))
    }else{
        return(which(grepl(x = erap2_ov_df[,"T..Protein.Names"], pattern = x) & grepl(x = erap2_ov_df[,"T..Protein.Names"], pattern = ";")))
    }
},1)
unimputed_effect_df$gene_names <- erap2_ov_df[gene_name_indexes,"T..Genes"]


all_biomart_info_df <- biomart_info_list$biomart_info
synonym_df <- biomart_info_list$synonyms

unimputed_effect_df$gene_id <- vapply(str_split(unimputed_effect_df$gene_names, pattern = ";"), function(x){
    # message(x)
    current_ranges <- annotation_gene_ranges[annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name %in% x]
    if(length(current_ranges) == 0){
        current_df <- all_biomart_info_df[all_biomart_info_df$hgnc_symbol == x,]
        if(nrow(current_df) == 0){
            current_df <- all_biomart_info_df[all_biomart_info_df$hgnc_symbol %in% unique(synonym_df[synonym_df$external_synonym %in% x,"hgnc_symbol"]),]
            if(nrow(current_df) == 0){
                return("NA")
            }
        }
        versions <- vapply(str_split(current_df$ensembl_gene_id_version, pattern = "\\."),function(x){
            as.numeric(x[2])
        },1)
        return(current_df$ensembl_gene_id[which.max(versions)])
    } else if(length(current_ranges) > 1){
        return(current_ranges$gene_id[which.max(current_ranges$gene_version)])
    }
    return(current_ranges$gene_id)
},"1")


```

- Fetch the set of significantly differentially enriched proteins

```{r}

select_differentially_enriched_proteins <- function(data_df, sig){
    all_diff_proteins <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(data_df$comparison), function(x){
        temp_df <- data_df[data_df$comparison == x,]
        if(sig == "fdr"){
            sig_data_df <- temp_df[temp_df[,sig] < 0.05,]
        }else if (sig == "pvalue"){
            sig_data_df <- temp_df[temp_df[,sig] > 0.3,]
        }
        rownames(sig_data_df) <- NULL
        return(sig_data_df)
    }))
    return(all_diff_proteins)
}

sig_unimputed_effect_df <- select_differentially_enriched_proteins(unimputed_effect_df, sig = "pvalue")


all_contrasts <- unique(unimputed_effect_df$comparison) 

significant_events_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_contrasts, function(x){
    sig_event_df <- unimputed_effect_df[
        unimputed_effect_df$comparison == x & 
        unimputed_effect_df$pvalue < 0.05,]
    sig_event_df$sig_group <- "unimputed"
    return(sig_event_df)
}))
rownames(significant_events_df) <- NULL

significant_events_df$direction[significant_events_df$logfc < 0] <- "down"
significant_events_df$direction[significant_events_df$logfc > 0] <- "up"
saveRDS(object = significant_events_df, file = file.path(save_dir, "02-03-erap2-ov-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))

significant_events_export_df <- significant_events_df[,c(1,10,2,13,3,4,5,9,11,12)]
write.csv(significant_events_export_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "erap2-ov-significantly-differentially-enriched-proteins-with-rots.csv"))


```

- save background set of proteins 

```{r}


all_proteins <- unique(unimputed_effect_df$protein_name)
split_de_results <- split(unimputed_effect_df, unimputed_effect_df$comparison)

protein_effect_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(all_proteins, function(x){
    logfc_val <- vapply(split_de_results, function(temp_df){
        temp_df[temp_df$protein_name == x,"logfc"]
    },1)
    pvalue_val <- vapply(split_de_results, function(temp_df){
        temp_df[temp_df$protein_name == x,"pvalue"]
    },1)


    data.frame(protein_name = x, 
        gene_id = unimputed_effect_df$gene_id[unimputed_effect_df$protein_name == x],
        erap2_vs_scramble_logfc = logfc_val["ERAP2_vs_SSCFP"],
        erap2_vs_scramble_pval = pvalue_val["ERAP2_vs_SSCFP"],
        erap2_vs_scramble_sig = ifelse("ERAP2_vs_SSCFP" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F),
        erap2_vs_untreated_logfc = logfc_val["ERAP2_vs_UN"],
        erap2_vs_untreated_pval = pvalue_val["ERAP2_vs_UN"],
        erap2_vs_untreated_sig = ifelse("ERAP2_vs_UN" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F),
        scramble_vs_untreated_logfc = logfc_val["SSCFP_vs_UN"],
        scramble_vs_untreated_pval = pvalue_val["SSCFP_vs_UN"],
        scramble_vs_untreated_sig = ifelse("SSCFP_vs_UN" %in% significant_events_df$comparison[match(x, significant_events_df$protein_name)], T, F))
}))
rownames(protein_effect_df) <- NULL
protein_effect_df$erap2_vs_scramble_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$erap2_vs_scramble_sig)] <- F
protein_effect_df$erap2_vs_untreated_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$erap2_vs_untreated_sig)] <- F
protein_effect_df$scramble_vs_untreated_sig[is.na(protein_effect_df$scramble_vs_untreated_sig)] <- F
write.csv(x = protein_effect_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "04-erap2-ov-background-protein-logfc-values.csv"))


```

- Plot frequency of differential expression

```{r}

frequency_df <- as.data.frame(table(significant_events_df$comparison, significant_events_df$direction))
colnames(frequency_df) <- c("comparison", "direction", "frequency")
frequency_df$comparison <- factor(frequency_df$comparison, levels = c("ERAP2_vs_SSCFP", "ERAP2_vs_UN", "SSCFP_vs_UN"))
prop_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(frequency_df, frequency_df$comparison), function(x){
    x <- x[rev(order(x$direction)),]
    x$prop <- x$frequency / sum(x$frequency)
    x$lab_y <-  cumsum(x$prop) - (0.5 * x$prop)
    return(x)
}))

```

- Plot frequency plots

```{r}

require("ggplot2")

my_theme <- theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1, angle = 45),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2))

Colours <- c("up" = "#D81E5B", "down" = "#3993DD")
the_plot <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = comparison, y = prop))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_col(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_text(data = prop_df, aes(x = comparison, y = lab_y, label = frequency), colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_x_discrete("comparisons")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_y_continuous("log10 frequency of differential expression")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_fill_manual("lfc direction", values = Colours)
the_plot <- the_plot + theme_bw()
the_plot <- the_plot + my_theme
ggsave(the_plot, file = file.path(plot_dir, "02-06-frequency-of-differential-protein-enrichment.pdf"), height = 9, width = 3)

```

- Highlight spliceosomal components

```{r}

path_to_proteins <- "19-investigating-the-spliceosomal-complexes/input_files"
all_complexes <- list.files(path_to_proteins)

all_splicing_complexes <- lapply(all_complexes, function(x){
    message(x)
    read.table(file = file.path(path_to_proteins, x), header = T, sep = "\t")
})

complex_proteins <- unique(do.call(c, lapply(all_splicing_complexes, function(x){
    all_proteins <- trimws(c(x[,2], do.call(c, str_split(x[,7], pattern = ","))))
    return(all_proteins[all_proteins != ""])
})))

significant_events_df$group <- "none"
significant_events_df$group[significant_events_df$gene_name %in% complex_proteins] <- "splicing"
significant_events_df$group[significant_events_df$gene_name == "ERAP2"] <- "ERAP2"

group_colours <- c("splicing" = "#F0A6CA", "ERAP2" = "#A5243D", "none" = "#F0E6EF")

ThePlot <- ggplot(unimputed_effect_df[unimputed_effect_df$comparison %in% c("ERAP2_vs_SSCFP"),], 
    aes(x = logfc, y = log_pvalue))
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(fill = "azure3", colour = "#000000", shape = 21, alpha = 0.6)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(data = significant_events_df[significant_events_df$comparison %in% "ERAP2_vs_SSCFP" & significant_events_df$group %in% c("splicing", "ERAP2"),], 
    aes(fill = group), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("log2 fold change")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_continuous("-log10(pvalue)")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_manual("groups", values = group_colours)
ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("volcano plot of comparisons")
# ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ comparison, scales = "free")
ThePlot <- ThePlot + current_theme
ggsave(width = 10, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "02-08-plot-volcano-plot-of-comparisons.pdf"), ThePlot)


```

- Perform GSEA for splicing components

```{r}

require("msigdbr")
require("fgsea")
require("parallel")

go_mf_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "human", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:MF")
msigdbr_list = split(x = go_mf_gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = go_mf_gene_sets$gs_name)


complex_list = lapply(all_splicing_complexes, function(x){
    x[,2]
})
names(complex_list) <- all_complexes
all_splicing_proteins <- unique(do.call(c, complex_list))

pathway_similarity <- vapply(msigdbr_list, function(x){
    length(intersect(x, all_splicing_proteins)) / length(union(x, all_splicing_proteins))
},1)

modified_msigdbr_list <- msigdbr_list[pathway_similarity < 0.1]
modified_msigdbr_list <- c(modified_msigdbr_list, complex_list)



all_de_df_split <- split(all_de_df, all_de_df$contrasts)

erap2_vs_scramble <- unimputed_effect_df[unimputed_effect_df$comparison %in% "ERAP2_vs_SSCFP",]

erap2_vs_scramble <- erap2_vs_scramble[order(erap2_vs_scramble$logfc, decreasing = T),]
a_vector <- erap2_vs_scramble$logfc
names(a_vector) <- erap2_vs_scramble$gene_names
# rank_vector <- 
gsea_results_df <- fgsea(modified_msigdbr_list, a_vector, maxSize = 200)


significant_gsea_df_list <- gsea_results_df[gsea_results_df$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(gsea_results_df$log2err) & gsea_results_df$pathway %in% names(complex_list),]


all_significant_reactome_gsea_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(significant_reactome_gsea_df_list), function(x){
    temp_df <- as.data.frame(significant_reactome_gsea_df_list[[x]])
    temp_df$contrast <- x
    return(temp_df)
}))

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "erap2_ov_NES_plots.pdf"))
plotEnrichment(modified_msigdbr_list[["complex_B_activator.txt"]], a_vector)
plotEnrichment(modified_msigdbr_list[["major_spliceosome.txt"]], a_vector)
dev.off()

saveRDS(object = all_significant_reactome_gsea_df, file = file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_reactome_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))




```
